blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Part-of-speech tagging is a fundamental sequence labeling task and an important component for many downstream natural language processing applications. However, Saraiki, written from right to left in a Perso-Arabic script, remains an under-resourced Indo-Aryan language, despite being spoken as a mother tongue by 28,849,579 people (approximately 28.9 million) according to Pakistan 7th Population and Housing Census 2023. This paper presents a manually annotated Saraiki Universal POS tagging dataset developed from plain-text. We annotated the text with 17 POS categories. We evaluate three pretrained transformer encoders under the same fine-tuning setup: XLM-RoBERTa base, Urdu RoBERTa small, and multilingual DistilBERT. Experimental results over five random seeds show that XLM-RoBERTa base achieves the best performance, with 87.29% +/- 0.21% development accuracy and 88.60% +/- 0.21% test accuracy. Urdu RoBERTa small and multilingual DistilBERT also provide competitive results, suggesting that multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders are effective for Saraiki UPOS tagging. The dataset, evaluation setup, and baseline results introduced in this work provide a benchmark for future research on Saraiki NLP and low-resource sequence labeling.
blocks.zh: 部分语句标记是一个基本的序列标记任务,也是许多下游自然语言处理应用的重要组成部分. 然而,Saraiki从右到左用佩尔索-阿拉伯文字写成,尽管根据2023年巴基斯坦第七次人口和住房普查,有28,849,579人(约2,890万人)作为母语使用,但仍然是资源不足的印阿里亚语. 本文介绍由纯文本开发的手动附加说明的Saraiki Universal POS标记数据集. 我们以17个POS类别对案文作了说明。 我们在同一微调装置下评价三台预训变压器编码器:XLM-RoBERTa基座,Urdu RoBERTa小座,以及多语种DistilBERT. 5个随机种子的实验结果显示,XLM-ROBERTA基座达到最佳性能,开发精度达到87.29%+/-0.21%,测试精度达到88.60%+/-0.21%. 乌尔都语 RoBERTa 小型和多语种 DistilBERT 也提供竞争结果,说明多语种和相关的文字预刻编码器对Saraiki UPOS 标记有效. 在这项工作中引入的数据集,评价设置,以及基准结果,为日后对Saraiki NLP和低资源序列标签的研究提供了一个基准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Part-of-speech tagging is a fundamental sequence labeling task that assigns grammatical categories such as noun, adjective, verb, and pronoun to tokens in a sentence. POS tags are useful for many downstream NLP tasks, including machine translation, syntactic parsing, named entity recognition, information extraction and linguistic corpus development [ 34 ] . For low-resource languages, POS-tagged corpora are especially important because they provide a basic layer of linguistic annotation for building and evaluating NLP tools [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 部分相声标记(Part-of-speech taging)是一种基本的序列标记任务,它将名词,形容词,动词等语法分类分配到句子中的代词. POS标签对许多下游NLP任务有用,包括机器翻译,综合剖析,被命名的实体识别,信息提取和语言学人文发展[34]. 对于低资源语言,POS标记的corpora尤为重要,因为它们为NLP工具的建设和评价提供了基本的语言注释层 [11].

blocks.en: Saraiki, also spelled Siraiki, is an Indo-Aryan language spoken mainly in Pakistan, particularly in Southern Punjab and neighboring regions [ 2 ] . According to Pakistan’s 7th Population and Housing Census 2023, Saraiki is reported as the mother tongue of 28,849,579 people, approximately 28.9 million, representing 12.00% of Pakistan’s population [ 22 ] . It is written from right to left in a Perso-Arabic script and is closely related to Punjabi and Sindhi. Despite this sizeable speaker community and its rich literary and oral tradition, Saraiki remains under-resourced in computational linguistics. Compared with high-resource languages, Saraiki has limited annotated benchmark datasets and fewer publicly available NLP tools. This lack of resources makes it challenging to develop robust systems for automatic language processing [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 萨拉伊克语(Saraiki)也拼作斯赖伊克语(Siraiki)是印度-雅利安语的一种语言,主要在巴基斯坦,特别是在南旁遮普和相邻地区[2]. 根据巴基斯坦2023年第七次人口和住房普查,Saraiki是28,849,579人的母语,约为2,890万人,占巴基斯坦人口的12.00% [22]. 它从右到左被用一个Perso-阿拉伯文字书写,与旁遮普语和信德语密切相关. 尽管这个庞大的演讲者社区及其丰富的文学和口语传统,但Saraiki在计算语言学方面仍然资源不足。 相较于高资源语言,Saraiki的注释基准数据集有限,可公开使用的NLP工具也较少. 由于缺乏资源,开发强大的自动语言处理系统具有挑战性[11].

blocks.en: Recent work has begun to address this gap. Alam et al. introduced the first Universal Dependencies treebank for Saraiki, containing 587 sentences and 7,597 tokens annotated using the Universal Dependencies framework [ 2 ] . Their work describes important syntactic and morphological properties of Saraiki, including split ergativity, light verb constructions, serial verb constructions, compounds, and relative clauses. We could not locate a public release of their annotated treebank. Other studies have proposed Saraiki-specific POS tagsets and linguistic annotation schemes. However, publicly available Saraiki UPOS resources and reproducible benchmarks for automatic POS tagging remain limited and there is still a need for additional manually annotated data and reproducible benchmark evaluations for automatic POS tagging.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始来弥补这一差距。 Alam等为Saraiki引入了首个通用依赖树库,包含587句和7,597个符号,使用通用依赖框架注释 [2]. 他们的作品描述了Saraiki的重要的合成和形态特征,包括分化对等,轻动词构造,串行动词构造,化合物,和相对条款等. 我们找不到他们的注解树库的公开发布 其他研究提出了Saraiki特有的POS标记集和语言注释计划. 然而,公开提供的Saraiki UPOS资源以及自动POS标记的可复制基准仍然有限,仍然需要额外的人工附加说明的数据以及自动POS标记的可复制基准评价.

blocks.en: Saraiki also presents challenges for NLP because of its linguistic and dialectal diversity. Recent work has shown that Saraiki dialects spoken in regions such as Multan and other areas exhibit noticeable lexical variation [ 30 ] . Such variation can affect vocabulary coverage, tokenization, and model generalization [ 11 ] . In addition, Saraiki shares script-level similarities with Urdu and Punjabi Shahmukhi, but it has its own grammatical and lexical properties [ 27 , 1 , 32 ] . These factors make it important to evaluate NLP models directly on Saraiki data rather than assuming that resources or models developed for related languages will transfer without loss [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: Saraiki因其语言和方言的多样性,也对NLP提出了挑战. 最近的工作显示,在诸如穆尔坦等地区和其他地区所讲的Saraiki方言表现出了显著的地语差异[30]. 这种变异会影响词汇的涵盖范围,标志化,模式通俗化[11]. 此外,Saraiki还分享了与乌尔都语和旁遮普语Shahmukhi的脚本级别相近之处,但是它有自己的语法和词典属性[27, 1, 32]. 这些因素使得在Saraiki数据上直接评价NLP模型的重要性,而不是假设为相关语言开发的资源或模型会不丢失地转移[26].

blocks.en: Universal POS tagging provides a useful framework for developing such resources. The Universal POS tagset offers a cross-linguistically consistent set of coarse-grained POS categories [ 18 ] . It is widely used in the Universal Dependencies project, which provides a common framework for morphological and syntactic annotation across languages [ 8 , 21 ] . Using UPOS annotation for Saraiki makes the resource compatible with multilingual NLP research and with existing UD-style resources for related Indo-Aryan languages.
blocks.zh: 通用POS标记为开发这些资源提供了一个有用的框架。 Universal POS标签集提供了一套在语言上一致的粗糙的POS类别[18]. 它被广泛用于通用依赖项目,该项目为不同语言的形态学和合成注释提供了共同的框架[8,21]. 使用 Saraiki 的 UPOS 注释使资源与多语言 NLP 研究相兼容,并与相关的印度-雅利安语言的现有 UP 风格资源相兼容.

blocks.en: In this paper, we address the lack of benchmark resources for Saraiki POS tagging by introducing a manually annotated Universal POS tagging dataset. The corpus is developed from plain-text Saraiki data and annotated with the Universal POS tag inventory [ 8 , 21 ] . It contains 17 UPOS categories and is divided into fixed train, development, and test splits to support reproducible evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过引入一个手动附加说明的通用POS标记数据集来解决Saraiki POS标记的基准资源的缺乏. 书目来源于Saraiki的纯文本数据,并附有通用POS标签目录[8,21]. 它包含17个UPOS类别,并被分为固定列车,开发,测试分出支持再生评价.

blocks.en: We further establish transformer-based baseline results for Saraiki UPOS tagging. Specifically, we compare multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders under a consistent experimental setting, including XLM-RoBERTa base, Urdu RoBERTa small, and multilingual DistilBERT. Our results show that XLM-RoBERTa base performs best, while Urdu RoBERTa small and multilingual DistilBERT provide competitive baselines. These findings suggest that multilingual pretraining and related-script representations are useful for Saraiki sequence labeling.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步确定Saraiki UPOS标记基于变压器的基准结果。 具体来说,我们比较了在一致的实验环境下,包括XLM-RoBERTa基础,Urdu RoBERT小型,以及多语种DistilBERT的多语种和相关文字预导编码器. 我们的结果显示,XLM-RoBERTa基座表现最好,而乌尔都语RoBERT小而多语言的DistilBERT则提供有竞争力的基线. 这些调查结果表明,多语种的预训和相关文字表述对于Saraiki序列的标签化很有用.

blocks.en: We summarize the contributions of this paper as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们总结本文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce a manually annotated Saraiki UPOS tagging dataset developed from plain-text Saraiki data, covering 17 Universal POS categories and released splits. • We establish baseline results for Saraiki UPOS tagging by evaluating multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders under a consistent experimental setting.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们引入了一个手动附加说明的Saraiki UPOS标记数据集,由Plain-text Saraiki数据开发,涵盖17个通用POS类别并发布分解. ^ 我们通过在一致的实验环境下评价多语种和相关的语句预导编码器,确定Saraiki UPOS标记的基准结果。

blocks.en: We introduce a manually annotated Saraiki UPOS tagging dataset developed from plain-text Saraiki data, covering 17 Universal POS categories and released splits.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个手动附加说明的 Saraiki UPOS 标记数据集,由平文本 Saraiki 数据开发,涵盖 17 个通用 POS 类别并发布分解.

blocks.en: We establish baseline results for Saraiki UPOS tagging by evaluating multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders under a consistent experimental setting.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在一致的实验环境下评价多语种和相关的语句预导编码器,确定Saraiki UPOS标记的基准结果。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: POS tagging has been widely studied as a core sequence labeling task in NLP [ 17 , 33 , 25 ] . Early POS tagging systems relied on rule-based methods, statistical models, and feature-based machine learning approaches [ 6 , 5 , 33 ] . More recent work has shifted toward neural and pretrained transformer-based models, which learn contextualized representations and can be fine-tuned for token-level classification tasks [ 12 , 14 , 9 , 19 ] . For low-resource languages, however, the lack of annotated data remains a major limitation [ 11 ] . In such settings, manually annotated corpora and reproducible baseline systems are important for both linguistic research and NLP tool development.
blocks.zh: POS标记在NLP[17,33,25]被作为核心序列标记任务被广泛研究. 早期的POS标记系统依赖于基于规则的方法,统计模型,以及基于特征的机器学习方法[6,5,33]. 最近的工作已经转向了神经学和先入为主的变压器模型,这些变压器学习了上下文化的表达方式,可以被微调以完成象征性的分类任务[12,14,9,19]. 然而,对于低资源语言而言,缺乏附加说明的数据仍然是一个重大限制[11]。 在这种环境下,人工注释的corpora和可复制的基线系统对语言研究和NLP工具开发都很重要.

blocks.en: Universal POS tagging provides a common framework for cross-linguistic POS annotation. The Universal POS tagset was introduced to support consistent annotation across languages using a small set of coarse-grained grammatical categories. It is now widely used in the Universal Dependencies framework, which provides annotation guidelines and treebanks for many languages [ 8 , 21 ] . UD-style annotation has supported multilingual research in parsing, morphology, and sequence labeling. However, coverage remains uneven, and many low-resource languages still lack sufficiently large annotated corpora [ 11 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 通用POS标记为跨语言POS注释提供了共同的框架. 通用POS标签集的被引入是为了支持使用一小组粗糙的语法类语言之间的一致注释. 它现在被广泛用于世界属地框架,该框架为许多语言提供了注释指南和树库[8,21]. UD风格的注解支持了多语种在剖析,形态学和序列标签方面的研究. 然而,覆盖面仍然不均衡,许多低资源语言仍然缺乏足够大的注解公司[11,20].

blocks.en: Several Universal Dependencies resources have been developed for Indo-Aryan languages. Existing UD treebanks include resources for Hindi, Urdu, Marathi, and Punjabi [ 31 , 4 , 10 , 24 , 3 ] . These resources show the usefulness of UD annotation for South Asian languages, but they also highlight the uneven availability of linguistic resources across the Indo-Aryan family. Major languages such as Hindi and Urdu have received more attention than smaller or regionally concentrated languages. As a result, many Indo-Aryan languages remain under-represented in computational resources and benchmark evaluations.
blocks.zh: 已经为印度-雅利安语开发出几种通用附属物资源。 现有的UD树库包括用于印地语、乌尔都语、马拉地语和旁遮普语的资源[31、4、10、24、3]。 这些资源显示了UD注释对南亚语言的有用性,但也突出了印度-雅利安家庭语言资源供应不均的情况。 主要语言如印地语和乌尔都语比较小或区域集中的语言得到更多的关注. 因此,许多印度-雅利安语言在计算资源和基准评价中仍然代表性不足.

blocks.en: Earlier Saraiki NLP work has also addressed POS tagset design and linguistic annotation proposed a POS tagset for morphological, syntactic, and lexical annotation of Saraiki [ 28 ] . Malik et al. [ 16 ] presented a hierarchical POS tagset for Saraiki with a richer set of language-specific categories. These studies are valuable because they document Saraiki-specific grammatical categories and provide foundations for linguistic annotation. However, language-specific tagsets may not be directly comparable across languages. In contrast, UPOS annotation supports multilingual comparison and compatibility with Universal Dependencies-style resources [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 早点说 NLP的工作还涉及了POS标记集设计以及语言学注释,为Saraiki的形态学,综合学,和词汇学注释提出了POS标记集[28]. 马利克等. [16] 提供了Saraiki的分级POS标签集,其中包含更丰富的语言特定类别. 这些研究很有价值,因为它们记录了Saraiki特定语法类别,并为语言注释提供基础. 然而,语言专用的标签集可能无法在语言之间直接进行比较. 相形之下,UPOS注释支持多语种比较,并与通用依赖类资源相兼容[8].

blocks.en: Saraiki also presents challenges because of dialectal and lexical variation spoken in different regions of Pakistan [ 30 ] . Their findings show that lexical choices vary across regional boundaries. Such variation is important for NLP because it can affect vocabulary coverage, tokenization, and model generalization. For POS tagging, dialectal variation may introduce different word forms or region-specific lexical items that are not equally represented in training data.
blocks.zh: Saraiki还提出了挑战,因为巴基斯坦不同地区使用的是方言和词汇差异[30]。 它们的调查结果表明,不同区域界线的词汇选择各不相同。 这种变异对NLP很重要,因为它会影响词汇的覆盖,标语化,和模型通俗化. 对于POS标记,方言变异可能引入不同的单词形式或区域特有词典项目,在培训数据中并不一致.

blocks.en: Transformer-based models have become the dominant approach for many sequence labeling tasks [ 35 , 9 ] . XLM-RoBERTa is a multilingual transformer trained on an extensive amount of data and has achieved strong results on many cross-lingual tasks [ 7 ] . DistilBERT provides a smaller and faster distilled transformer model while retaining much of the performance of the original transformer architecture [ 29 ] . For Saraiki, related-script models are also relevant because Saraiki is written in Perso-Arabic script and shares script-level similarities with Urdu and Punjabi Shahmukhi [ 27 , 1 , 32 ] . Therefore, Urdu-focused pretrained models may provide useful representations for Saraiki text.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的模型已成为许多序列标签任务的主导方法[35,9]. XLM-ROBERTa是一个多语言变形器,经过大量数据培训,在许多跨语言任务上取得了强劲的成果[7]. DistilBERT提供了更小更快的蒸馏变压器模型,同时保留了原变压器架构的大部分性能[29]. 对于Saraiki来说,相关的标注模型也是相关的,因为Saraiki是用Perso-Arabic脚本书写的,并与乌尔都语和旁遮普语Shahmukhi[27, 1, 32]分享了脚本层次的相似性. 因此,以乌尔都语为重点的预先训练的模型可以为Saraiki文本提供有用的表述.

blocks.en: Overall, previous work has provided important foundations for Saraiki linguistic annotation, including POS tagsets and a small Universal Dependencies treebank. However, benchmark-style evaluation of pretrained transformer encoders for Saraiki UPOS tagging remains limited. This paper addresses this gap by manually annotating Saraiki plain text with Universal POS tags and evaluating three pretrained transformer models under a fixed train–development–test setup.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,前作为Saraiki语言注释提供了重要的基础,包括POS标签集和小型通用依赖树库. 然而,对Saraiki UPOS标记预训变压器编码器的基准式评价仍然有限。 本文通过手动将Saraiki平原文本与通用POS标记进行注释,并在固定列车-开发-测试设置下评估了3个预训变压器模型来弥补这一缺口.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3 数据集建设

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Source
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据来源

blocks.en: The source data contains Saraiki text written in the Perso-Arabic script [ 13 ] . Since the original dataset was plain text, it did not provide token boundaries, POS labels, morphological features, or dependency relations. We therefore manually processed and annotated the data for Universal POS tagging. The goal was to create a resource suitable for training and evaluating automatic Saraiki POS taggers.
blocks.zh: 出处数据包含由Perso-Arabic脚本所写的Saraiki文本[13]. 由于原始数据集是纯正文本,因此没有提供符号边界,POS标签,形态特征,或依赖关系. 因此,我们手动处理和注释通用POS标记的数据。 目标是创建一个适合培训和评估自动Saraiki POS标记器的资源。

blocks.en: Saraiki is written from right to left and shares script-level properties with Urdu and Punjabi Shahmukhi. However, it also has its own lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. For this reason, we kept the text in its original Saraiki script and did not transliterate it into Roman script or any other writing system. This allows the resulting dataset to reflect the form in which Saraiki is commonly written and processed.
blocks.zh: Saraiki从右到左并和乌尔都语和旁遮普语Shahmukhi分享脚本级属性. 然而,它也具有自有的词典,形态学,和合成特征. 为此,我们保留了原作"萨拉伊克"(Saraiki)脚本中的文字,没有将文字转写为罗马文字或任何其他书写系统. 这使得由此产生的数据集能够反映Saraiki通常被写作和处理的形式.

blocks.en: 3.2 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.2 预处理

blocks.en: Before annotation, we cleaned the raw text by removing empty lines, unusable rows, and duplicate or malformed entries where necessary. We also normalized whitespace while preserving the original script. Since the aim of this work is to evaluate Saraiki POS tagging in its native writing system, no translation or transliteration was applied.
blocks.zh: 在注释前,我们清除了原始文本,删除了空行,无法使用行,并在必要时复制或变形条目。 我们还在保留原始脚本的同时实现了白空间的正常化. 由于这项工作的目的是评价Saraiki POS在其本土写作系统中的标记,因此没有应用翻译或转写.

blocks.en: The cleaned sentences were then manually segmented into tokens. Each sentence was converted into CoNLL-U style format, where each token appears on a separate line with its corresponding annotation fields [ 21 ] . Since the present work focuses on Universal POS tagging, we annotate the UPOS column and leave the XPOS, morphological-feature, and dependency fields unspecified [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 之后,这些被清理的句子被手动分割成符号. 每个句子被转换为CONLL-U风格格式,其中每个符符都以相对应的注字字字段单行出现. [21]. 由于目前的工作侧重于通用POS标记,因此我们将UPOS一栏注出,并留下XPOS,形态地貌和依赖地字段未注明 [8].

blocks.en: 3.3 UPOS Label Inventory
blocks.zh: 3.3 UPOS标签清单

blocks.en: We annotate the dataset using the Universal POS tag inventory [ 21 ] . The UPOS tagset provides a small set of coarse-grained grammatical categories that can be applied consistently across languages. This makes the dataset compatible with Universal Dependencies-style annotation and allows comparison with POS tagging resources for other languages.
blocks.zh: 我们使用通用POS标签目录对数据集进行注释 [21]. UPOS标记集提供了一套可以一致地跨语言应用的粗糙的语法分类. 这使得数据集与Universal Dependents风格的注解兼容,并允许与其他语言的POS标记资源进行比较.

blocks.en: The dataset contains 17 UPOS categories:
blocks.zh: 数据集包含17个UPOS类别:

blocks.en: ADJ ADP ADV AUX CCONJ DET INTJ NOUN NUM PART PRON PROPN PUNCT SCONJ SYM VERB X
blocks.zh: ADJ ADP ADV AUX CONJ DET INTJ NOUM Part PRONP PCONJ SYM VERB X 中超联赛 中超联赛 中超联赛 中超联赛 中超联赛

blocks.en: Each token is assigned exactly one UPOS label. Tokens that function as common nouns are annotated as NOUN , while proper names are annotated as PROPN . Main lexical verbs are annotated as VERB , and auxiliary elements are annotated as AUX . Adpositions and postpositions are annotated as ADP . Punctuation marks are annotated as PUNCT . The label X is used for tokens that cannot be assigned to one of the regular grammatical categories.
blocks.zh: 每个令牌被指定一个UPOS标签。 普通名词的缩写为NOUN, 主要词典动词被注解为VERB.,而辅助元素被注解为AUX. 职位和职位附加说明为ADP。 标注标记为PCONF 。 标签 X 用于不能被指定为正文法类之一的符号.

blocks.en: 3.4 Manual Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.4 人工注释

blocks.en:
The annotation was carried out manually using the Universal POS
tag inventory. One annotator, who holds an MPhil in Linguistics and
has experience in linguistic annotation, assigned a UPOS label to
each token according to its grammatical function in context. Two
PhD students independently reviewed the entire annotated dataset
for correctness and made manual corrections where needed. Difficult
cases were considered in sentence context, since the same surface
form may belong to different grammatical categories depending on
usage.

blocks.en: The annotation process focused on producing a consistent token-level POS resource. Since there is no widely adopted large-scale Saraiki POS benchmark, we followed the Universal POS categories rather than a language-specific tagset. This choice supports cross-linguistic comparability and makes the dataset easier to use with existing multilingual NLP models and Universal Dependencies-oriented tools.
blocks.zh: 注释过程侧重于生成一个一致的符号级POS资源. 由于没有被广泛采用的大规模Saraiki POS基准,我们遵循了Universal POS类别,而不是语言专用的标签集. 这种选择支持跨语言的可比较性,使数据集更容易与现有的多语言NLP模型和面向通用依赖性的工具一起被使用.

blocks.en: Some annotation decisions are especially relevant for Saraiki. Verbal elements were annotated according to their function as main verbs or auxiliaries. Nouns and proper nouns were distinguished based on whether the token referred to a general entity or a named entity. Pronouns, determiners, and relative forms were annotated according to their syntactic function in the sentence. These decisions are important because Saraiki shares several grammatical patterns with related Indo-Aryan languages, but also has language-specific variation.
blocks.zh: 一些注释决定与Saraiki特别相干. 口头要素根据其作为主要动词或辅词的功能而作注释. 对名词和适当的名词加以区分的根据是该名词是指普通实体还是被命名的实体。 代名词,定子和相对形式都根据其在句子中的合成功能附加了注释. 这些决定很重要,因为Saraiki与相關的印地語-雅利安語有好几种语法模式相通,但也具有语言特异性.

blocks.zh: 3.5 数据分割

The training split is used for model fine-tuning, the development split is used for best checkpoint selection, and the test split is reserved for final evaluation. Keeping fixed splits allows future work to compare results under the same evaluation setting. Table 1 shows the distribution of sentences and tokens across the dataset splits.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Saraiki UPOS tagging using the fixed splits described in Section 3 and repeat each experiment using five random seeds (42–46) and report the mean and sample standard deviation of accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们用第3节所描述的固定分数来评价Saraiki UPOS标记,并用五个随机种子(42-46)重复每个实验,并报告精确度的平均值和样本标准差.

blocks.en: 5.1 Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 模式

blocks.en:
We compare three pretrained transformer encoders under the same
token classification setup. 1 1 1 Pretrained checkpoints:
XLM-RoBERTa base, https://huggingface.co/FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base ,
Urdu RoBERTa small, https://huggingface.co/urduhack/roberta-urdu-small ,
multilingual DistilBERT, https://huggingface.co/distilbert/distilbert-base-multilingual-cased . The selected models include multilingual and related-script encoders. XLM-RoBERTa base is included as a strong multilingual model trained on large-scale multilingual data [ 7 ] . Urdu RoBERTa small is included because Saraiki and Urdu are both written in Perso-Arabic script and may share useful script-level representations [ 27 , 1 ] . Multilingual DistilBERT is included as a faster and lighter multilingual baseline [ 29 ] .

blocks.en: All models are fine-tuned using AdamW optimization and a linear learning rate schedule with warmup [ 15 ] . The dropout probability is set to 0.10.

The results show that the choice of pretrained encoder has a clear
effect on Saraiki UPOS tagging performance. XLM-RoBERTa base achieves
the strongest mean result, with 87.29% development accuracy and

mean test result at 86.85%, followed by multilingual DistilBERT
at 86.03%.

blocks.en: The ranking of the models is consistent across the development and test sets. XLM-RoBERTa base performs best on both splits, followed by Urdu RoBERTa small and multilingual DistilBERT. This consistency suggests that the observed differences are not specific to a single split.
blocks.zh: 模型的排名在开发和测试集之间是一致的。 XLM-RoBERTA基础在两种分法上表现最好,其次是乌尔都语RoBERT小而多语言的DistilBERT. 这种一致性表明,观察到的差异并非针对单一的分割。

blocks.en:
XLM-RoBERTa base improves over multilingual DistilBERT by
2.57 percentage points on the test set and over Urdu RoBERTa
small by 1.75 percentage points. These results indicate that large-scale multilingual pretraining provides a measurable advantage for Saraiki UPOS tagging. At the same time, Urdu RoBERTa small remains competitive despite being smaller than XLM-RoBERTa base, suggesting that related-script pretraining can also be useful for Saraiki text.

XLM- RoBERTA 基础比多语种改进
2.57 测试集和乌尔都-罗贝塔
小于1.75个百分点。 这些结果显示,大规模多语种预训为Saraiki UPOS标记提供了可测量的优势. 同时,乌尔都-罗贝塔小虽然比XLM-罗贝塔基础还小,但依然具有竞争力,这表明相关的作文前行训练对萨拉基克文本也可能有用.

blocks.en: Multilingual DistilBERT obtains the lowest accuracy among the three models, but it still provides a competitive lightweight baseline. Its result shows that smaller multilingual encoders can be useful when computational efficiency is important, although they may not match the accuracy of larger multilingual models.
blocks.zh: 多语言DistilBERT在三种模型中获得了最低的精度,但它仍然提供了一个竞争性的轻量级基线. 它的结果显示,在计算效率重要的时候,较小的多语种编码器可以有用,尽管它们可能不匹配更大的多语种模型的准确性.

blocks.en: Overall, the results suggest that multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders are suitable for Saraiki UPOS tagging. XLM-RoBERTa base is the strongest model under the current setup, while Urdu RoBERTa small and multilingual DistilBERT provide useful alternative baselines.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,多语种和相关的被先行规范的编码器适合Saraiki UPOS标记. XLM-ROBERTA基础是当前设置下最强的模型,而乌尔都语RoBERTA小而多语言的DistilBERT提供了有用的替代基线.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: The results demonstrate that pretrained transformer encoders can be effective for Saraiki UPOS tagging, but the choice of encoder remains important. The strongest performance is achieved by XLM-RoBERTa base, which suggests that broad multilingual pretraining and wider subword coverage are beneficial for low-resource token classification.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,预训变压器编码器对Saraiki UPOS标记有效,但编码器的选择仍然很重要. XLM-RoBERTA基础实现了最强的性能,这表明广泛的多语种预训和更广泛的分词覆盖有利于低资源符号分类.

blocks.en: The performance of Urdu RoBERTa small is also notable. Although Urdu and Saraiki are different languages, both are written in Perso-Arabic script and share some orthographic patterns. This may help an Urdu-focused model represent Saraiki tokens more effectively than expected. However, Urdu RoBERTa small still remains below XLM-RoBERTa base, indicating that related-script pretraining is helpful but does not fully replace the benefits of broader multilingual pretraining.
blocks.zh: 乌尔都-罗贝塔小区的表现也值得一提. 虽然乌尔都语和萨拉伊克语是不同的语言,但两者都用佩尔索-阿拉伯文字书写并分享了部分正文图案. 这可能帮助一个以乌尔都语为重点的模型比预期更有效地代表了Saraiki符号. 然而,乌尔都语RoBERTa小区仍低于XLM-RoBERTa基数,这表明相关的语序前培训很有帮助,但并不能完全取代更广泛的多语种前培训的好处.

blocks.en: These findings also highlight the value of building annotated resources for Saraiki. Existing Saraiki NLP resources remain limited, and manually annotated UPOS data can support the development and evaluation of automatic taggers. The dataset can also serve as a foundation for future work on morphological analysis, dependency parsing, and other downstream NLP tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果还突出了为Saraiki建立附加说明的资源的价值。 现有的Saraiki NLP资源仍然有限,手动附加说明的UPOS数据可以支持自动标记器的开发和评价. 数据集还可以作为今后在形态分析,依赖剖析,以及其他下游NLP任务等工作的基础.

blocks.en: At the same time, the current work focuses only on coarse-grained UPOS tagging. Saraiki has rich morphology and several language-specific grammatical phenomena, including light verb constructions, serial verb constructions, split ergativity, and dialectal variation. Future work should therefore extend the corpus with morphological features, language-specific POS tags, and dependency relations.
blocks.zh: 同时,目前的工作只注重粗粗的UPOS标记. 萨拉伊克有丰富的形态学和几种语言特有的语法现象,包括轻动词构造,串行动词构造,分相通论,和方言变化. 因此,今后的工作应当扩大该实体,使之具有形态特征、语言专用的POS标记和依赖关系。

blocks.en: Overall, the dataset and baseline results provide a starting point for more systematic research on Saraiki NLP and low-resource sequence labeling.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,数据集和基线结果为更系统地研究Saraiki NLP和低资源序列标签提供了一个起点.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced a manually annotated Saraiki Universal POS tagging dataset developed from plain-text Saraiki data. The corpus was annotated with the Universal POS tag inventory and converted into CoNLL-U format, providing fixed train, development, and test splits for reproducible evaluation.
blocks.zh: 本文引入了由Plain-text Saraiki数据开发的手动附加说明的Saraiki Universal POS标记数据集. 该套装被附加了通用POS标签目录并被转换为CONLL-U格式,提供固定列车,开发,测试分型进行可再生评价.

blocks.en: We established transformer-based baselines for Saraiki UPOS tagging by fine-tuning XLM-RoBERTa base, Urdu RoBERTa small, and multilingual DistilBERT under a consistent token classification setup. The results show that multilingual and related-script pretrained encoders are effective for Saraiki sequence labeling, with XLM-RoBERTa base providing the strongest overall performance among the evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 通过微调XLM-RoBERTa基座,乌尔都-罗BERT小座,以及多语种DistilBERT,我们为Saraiki UPOS标记设定了基于变压器的基线。 结果显示,多语种和相關的被先行刻制的编码器对于Saraiki序列标签有效,由XLM-RoBERTa基提供被评价模型中最强的整体性能.

blocks.en: Overall, this work provides a benchmark resource and baseline results for Saraiki POS tagging. The dataset can support future research on low-resource NLP, Universal Dependencies-oriented annotation, and downstream Saraiki language processing. Future work will expand the corpus with additional data, morphological features, and dependency relations, and will explore further modeling approaches such as CRF decoding, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and data augmentation.
blocks.zh: 总之,这项工作为Saraiki POS标记提供了基准资源和基线结果。 数据集可以支持未来对低资源NLP,面向通用依赖的注解,下游Saraiki语言处理的研究. 今后的工作将增加数据、形态特征和依赖关系,并探索通用报告格式解码、参数效率微调和数据增强等进一步的建模方法。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, the dataset is limited in size compared with POS-tagged corpora available for high-resource languages. Although the manually annotated corpus provides a useful benchmark for Saraiki UPOS tagging, larger datasets would likely improve model performance and support more reliable evaluation across different genres and dialects.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性。 首先,与高资源语言可用的POS标记的corpora相比,数据集的大小有限. 虽然手动附加说明书为Saraiki UPOS标记提供了有用的基准,但更大的数据集可能会改善模型性能,支持对不同流派和方言进行更可靠的评价.

blocks.en: Second, the present work focuses only on Universal POS tags. UPOS categories are useful for cross-linguistic comparison, but they do not capture the full range of Saraiki-specific morphological and syntactic information. Saraiki has rich verbal morphology, case marking, light verb constructions, serial verb constructions, and other language-specific phenomena. Future versions of the corpus should include morphological features, language-specific POS tags, and dependency relations.
blocks.zh: 其次,本作仅关注通用POS标签. UPOS分类对跨语言比较很有用,但它们并没有捕捉到Saraiki特有的形态学和合成信息的全部范围. 萨拉基语有丰富的口语形态,案例标记,轻动词构造,串行动词构造等语言特有现象. 未来版本的本体应包括形态特征、语言专用的POS标记和依赖关系。

blocks.en:
Third, INTJ, SYM, and X have no examples in the test set, so their
test performance cannot be assessed. The per-class analysis is
reported for one checkpoint selected using development accuracy;
the main accuracy comparison is reported over five random seeds.
blocks.zh:
第三,INTJ,SYM,和X在测试集中没有实例,所以它们
测试性能无法评估。 每类分析是:
使用开发精度选定一个检查站;
主要准确性比较报告为5个随机种子。

blocks.en: Fourth, the model comparison is limited to three pretrained transformer encoders. These models provide useful multilingual and related-script baselines, but additional models should be evaluated in future work. This includes larger multilingual encoders, regional language models, Urdu and Punjabi-focused models, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods.
blocks.zh: 第四,模型比较仅限于三台预装变压器编码器. 这些模型提供了有用的多语种和相关描述基线,但在今后的工作中应评价其他模型。 这包括更大的多语种编码器,区域语言模型,乌尔都语和旁遮普语重点模型,以及参数高效的微调方法.

blocks.en:
Finally, the annotation process may involve difficult linguistic decisions, especially for ambiguous tokens whose POS category depends on context. Since Saraiki also has dialectal and lexical variation, some forms may be used differently across regions. Although two experts reviewed the full corpus, the same sentences
were not independently annotated from scratch by multiple annotators,
and inter-annotator agreement was not measured. Future work should
document more detailed annotation guidelines and use independent
annotation of a representative subset to measure agreement.
blocks.zh:
最后,注解过程可能涉及语言上的困难决定,特别是对于POS类别取决于上下文的模糊符号. 由于Saraiki也有方言和词典的变异,一些形式可能会被不同区域不同地使用. 虽然有两位专家审查了整个案卷,但判决相同
没有从头到尾独立说明,
并且没有衡量通知人之间的协议。 今后的工作应
文档更详细的注释准则并独立使用
说明用于衡量协议的代表性子集。

blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work uses Saraiki plain-text data and manually annotates it for Universal POS tagging. The dataset is intended for research on low-resource NLP and language technology development. The corpus may reflect biases, dialectal preferences, or domain-specific patterns present in the original text source. Models trained on this dataset should therefore be used with care, especially outside the domain represented by the data. The resource and models are not intended for high-stakes decision-making.
blocks.zh: 这部作品使用Saraiki纯文本数据,并手动注释它用于通用POS标记. 该数据集旨在研究低资源NLP和语言技术发展. 主体可能反映原文本出处中存在的偏差,方言偏好,或域特有模式. 因此,应谨慎使用关于这一数据集的培训模型,特别是在数据所代表的领域之外。 这些资源和模式并非用于高层次的决策。
